Acknowledgment

By signing below, the client agrees to the credit terms outlined above, including the agreed late fee on past-due balances and responsibility for all collection and legal costs incurred to recover past-due funds.

Reconciliation

Reconciliation clause acknowledged: the Company may request the client's ledger at any time a balance remains open on this account. The client agrees to provide such ledger records within 72 hours of the request. Refusal or failure to provide the requested records within this window will render the full outstanding balance immediately due, and will suspend the credit terms outlined in this Agreement.

Company Discretion

Company reserves the right to reduce, suspend, or revoke credit at any time in its sole discretion. Unless otherwise agreed in writing, all payments received will be applied to the oldest outstanding balance first.
